mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the recovery copy on an isolated reader was most worthwhile: it demonstrated that the map correction could be restored without claiming to settle Moth's identity.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the tested cartridge to the cradle felt like a small preparatory step rather than an interesting decision, though its purpose was clear.

surprise.text: Moth's question about whether the copy was itself gave an otherwise practical backup a more uncertain personal dimension.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the cradle explicitly awaited the tested backup, even if attaching it was straightforward.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how Moth and the neighborhood use the repaired infrastructure, although this chapter's combinations were mostly predictable.
